instruction_text: Speak directly to one listener with warmth and a smile in your voice; calm, steady and reassuring, like a favorite morning radio host, while keeping the news clear and credible.
asr_text: It just doesn't feel right to me to pay for redelivery. My husband and I are both out of the house for work. For packages where I can choose, I pick a day and time when I know I'll be home. But once, I chose a morning delivery time slot, and the package didn't come. I went out to do an errand. When I got back, there was a delivery notice. Many packages don't let you choose a delivery time either, so you don't know ahead of time when they'll arrive. Before they charge us, I want them to first do a better job of coming at the time we chose. I also want them to tell us when the package will arrive. The delivery workers are probably having a hard time because there are too few of them. Maybe nothing can be done about that, but I can't accept having to pay for it. Am I wrong to feel that way?
